content: अधिष्ठातृ [स्था-तृच्] Superintending, watching over, presiding over, guiding, governing; हनूमांश्चाप्यधिष्ठाता <ls>Rām. 5. 63. 22</ls>; tutelary guardian; as ˚त्री देवता a guardian or presiding deity. {%m.%} ({@-ता@}) A superintendent, head, chief, protector, controller, regulator, ruler; सर्वेन्द्रियाधिष्ठाता <ls>Bhāṣā P.</ls>; especially with reference to the Almighty who is the ruler of the universe. See अधिदेव also.
